name: memory
description: 统一记忆工具（action 分派）。action=save 保存一条长期记忆到记忆宫殿（hall：decision/event/discovery/preference/suggestion；preference/suggestion 自动存入全局 user 翼，其余存入当前项目翼）；action=search 深度检索记忆宫殿（L3 全量跨翼 BM25，可按 wing/room/hall 过滤，结果含 id）；action=list_rooms 列出记忆宫殿结构（翼→房间→厅 与数量）；action=update 按 id 修正一条记忆（room/hall/verbatim/insight/tags/importance/pinned 任选，至少一项）；action=delete 按 id 删除被推翻的记忆；action=pin 按 id 置顶/取消置顶。发现新旧记忆矛盾时：先 search 取 id，能判定就 update 修正或 delete 旧条目，无法判定就用提问工具向用户澄清，禁止并存两条互斥记忆。
description_en: Unified memory tool (dispatched by action). action=save stores a long-term memory into the memory palace (hall: decision/event/discovery/preference/suggestion; preference/suggestion go to the global 'user' wing, others to the current project wing); action=search deep-searches the palace (L3 full cross-wing BM25, filterable by wing/room/hall, results include ids); action=list_rooms lists the palace structure (wing→room→hall with counts); action=update revises a memory by id (any of room/hall/verbatim/insight/tags/importance/pinned, at least one); action=delete removes a superseded memory by id; action=pin pins/unpins a memory by id. On contradictory memories: search to get the id, then update or delete the outdated entry when the winner is clear; otherwise ask the user for clarification. Never keep two mutually exclusive memories.

id.description: update/delete/pin：目标记忆 id（search 结果中提供）
id.description_en: update/delete/pin: target memory id (provided in search results)

room.description: save：主题房间名（英文小写连字符，如 context-engine；同类主题保持同名以形成关联）；update：可选，修改所属房间
room.description_en: save: topic room name (lowercase hyphenated, e.g. context-engine; reuse the same name for related topics); update: optional, move to another room

hall.description: 记忆分类（save 必填；search 可选过滤；update 可选修改）
hall.description_en: Memory category (required for save; optional filter for search; optional change for update)

verbatim.description: save：对话原文片段（保留关键原话，供追溯）；update：可选修正
verbatim.description_en: save: original text fragment from the conversation (keeps key quotes for traceability); update: optional revision

insight.description: save：一句话洞察（将来注入上下文的内容，要自包含、无歧义）；update：可选修正
insight.description_en: save: one-sentence insight (injected into future contexts; self-contained and unambiguous); update: optional revision

tags.description: save：标签（可选，便于过滤）；update：可选替换标签
tags.description_en: save: tags (optional, for filtering); update: optional replacement tags

importance.description: save：重要性 0-1（>=0.75 进入关键事实常驻层；默认 0.5）；update：可选修正
importance.description_en: save: importance 0-1 (>=0.75 enters the always-on key facts layer; default 0.5); update: optional revision

pinned.description: pin：true=置顶（进入 L1 关键事实常驻层）/false=取消置顶；update 可选
pinned.description_en: pin: true=pinned (enters the always-on L1 key facts layer) / false=unpin; optional for update

query.description: search：检索查询（自然语言关键词）

wing.description: search：限定翼（项目名或 'user'；缺省=全翼检索）
wing.description_en: search: restrict to a wing (project name or 'user'; default = all wings)

topK.description: search：返回条数上限（默认 10，最大 50）
